_sources.rain: World Bank WDI AG.LND.PRCP.MM (FAO AQUASTAT long-term avg), latest value 2022 (ISR 2021): https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/AG.LND.PRCP.MM ; gaps: WB Climate Change Knowledge Portal CRU TS4.08 1991-2020 country means https://cckpapi.worldbank.org/cckp/v1/ ; Taiwan WRA
_sources.waterStress: WRI Aqueduct 4.0 country rankings (2023, baseline 1979-2019, bws, weight=Tot): https://files.wri.org/aqueduct/aqueduct-4-0-country-rankings.zip ; fallback FAO SDG 6.4.2 via WB ER.H2O.FWST.ZS (2022): https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/ER.H2O.FWST.ZS
_sources.pvout: World Bank/ESMAP & Solargis, Global Photovoltaic Power Potential by Country (2020), avg practical potential PVOUT Level 1: https://datacatalogfiles.worldbank.org/ddh-published/0038379/1/DR0046831/solargis_pvpotential_countryranking_2020_data.xlsx ; gaps: Global Solar Atlas API point samples (2026) https://api.globalsolaratlas.info/data/lta
_sources.landPrice: Eurostat apri_lprc (2024; IT 2020; MT 2023): https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/api/dissemination/statistics/1.0/data/apri_lprc ; USDA ERS farmland value (2026): https://www.ers.usda.gov/topics/farm-economy/land-use-land-value-tenure/farmland-value ; others: reasoned order-of-magnitude estimates from national statistics/agency reports known to 2025 (Destatis, Savills, Rural Bank, REINZ, FCC/StatCan, MGAP-DIEA, etc.) and listings
_sources.growing: Judgement score informed by CRU TS4.08 1991-2020 monthly temperature & precipitation (WB CCKP) length-of-growing-period proxy, arable %, soils and irrigation potential

_method: rain/renewWater/arable/forest/density = latest non-empty WDI value (mrnev=1). waterStress = Aqueduct 4.0 baseline water stress country score 0-5 (weighted by total gross demand). Where Aqueduct has NoData (mostly small islands) the FAO SDG 6.4.2 freshwater-withdrawal stress % was converted with Aqueduct's own scale: score = clamp(ln(r/0.1)/ln2 + 1, 0, 5), r = stress/100 (correlation with Aqueduct where both exist r=0.70; FAO tends to rate arid exporters lower). Remaining gaps (Taiwan, HK, Macau, Monaco, Kosovo, Pacific atolls etc.) are reasoned estimates; see _waterStressSource. pvout = Solargis/World Bank 2020 country average practical potential (Level 1), kWh/kWp/day; NOR/SWE/RUS/CAN averaged only up to 60N; Kosovo taken from code XKO; TWN/MCO/FIN from Global Solar Atlas point samples; ISL estimated (outside satellite coverage). landPrice = typical rural/agricultural land for a community outside prime/tourist zones, USD/ha, order-of-magnitude. EU members use Eurostat national arable-land average (converted at the annual EUR/USD rate of the data year) except Portugal (national figure skewed by tiny northern plots; Alentejo/interior used) and Belgium (2014 data uprated). City-states with no rural land (MCO, MAC, SGP, HKG) carry deliberately extreme urban/development values; PRK is null (no market). Notes flag foreign-ownership limits where significant. growing = 0-100 judgement of food-growing conditions for the best realistic regions blended with the national average: season length (CRU monthly T>=~10C and P>=0.5*Thornthwaite PET), soil fertility, rainfall reliability, irrigation potential. est=true if ANY field for that country is an estimate (see _estFields for which). Raw downloads in research/raw_res/; build script research/build_resources.py.
